title: How I got here
lead: I started behind a hotel front desk, not behind a code editor. Technology came later, from what I saw there: today it is what lets me translate between what operations needs and what the product can do.

steps.title: Hospitality
steps.line: I started as a lifeguard at a hotel. Then came corporate reception at Dorna Sports during the MotoGP seasons, and years on hotel and apart-hotel front desks.

steps.title: Operations
steps.line: From the front desk into the operation itself: availability, room allocation, channels, billing and pricing, with PMS such as Opera or Avalon and OTAs such as Booking.com or Expedia.

steps.title: Technology
steps.line: Higher Vocational Qualification in Web Application Development; an internship at Dorna Sports, freelance work for Acerko.com and my own product, Tanya Martelli Photography, which I have maintained since 2024.

items.title: Real operational context
items.text: I have used hotel software from the front desk, not just in a demo.

items.title: A bridge between client and engineering
items.text: I can talk to the front desk and to developers and have both understand the same thing.

items.title: Ability to build
items.text: I can put together a prototype, integrate an API or maintain a product in production.
